criteria.statement: A committed offline artifact holds one embedding vector per rule index entry
EMBEDDING_PROVIDER (mock|local|openai, default mock) exists and never auto-switches on environment
EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=mock performs no embedding and makes no external call
EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=local embeds the query in-process and cosine-ranks it against the committed vectors
The async route handler embeds the query and passes the vector into preparePromptInput as an option; preparePromptInput stays synchronous
The exact-rule-id/parent-rule-id boost is merged with semantic ranking
On any embedding failure, System 3 falls back to lexical retrieval, still returns up to 5 excerpts, and emits one diagnostic warning
System 3 stays capped at 5 excerpts, deduplicated against System 2 by rule-number prefix
The shipped quantised model's clean/multi-card recall@5 are re-measured against the full-precision reference
system3-expected-recall and system3-noise-excluded run against the semantic path using committed frozen query embeddings with no live call
lambda-package-budget.test.mjs is green with the bundled model present and NON_DATA_RESERVE re-measured
Every PRD/sections/ location this slice owns matches its accepted GATE-QUESTIONS.md text

criteria.statement: A human confirmed no live-network call occurs under EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=mock or =local by reading the code path
